description: React component for a Kanban board column, including editing, deleting, and rendering cards.

methods.name: validateNewTitle
methods.description: Validates the new column title to ensure it's not empty or unchanged.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing of the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title after validation, handling success and error feedback.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events for the title input, triggering save or cancel.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes the column and shows success toast.
